title: QR Code for Member's Dashboard | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
content: QR Code for Member's Dashboard Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000097946 A QR code can be displayed in the Member Dashboard by enabling the appropriate setting in the Membership Plan. Enabling the QR Code Module Log in to the Admin Area. Navigate to Finance → Membership Plans . Edit the Membership Plan where the QR code should be displayed. Open the Member's Dashboard tab. Locate the Show QR Code Module setting. The keyword filter can be used to find it quickly. Set the option to Yes . Click Save Changes . Note: The QR code is only displayed for members whose profiles are searchable. For additional information about the Show QR Code Module setting, refer to: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000049066-finance-membership-plans-member-dashboard#section-3-dashboard-display-settings For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard .
